input.title: MCP proxy input
input.description: Configures the upstream MCP server the proxy connects to. Standby runs use the default values, so change the defaults to wrap a different server.

mcpServerCommand.title: MCP server command
mcpServerCommand.description: Command line that starts a stdio MCP server inside the Actor container. Used when no MCP server URL is set. Make sure the server package is listed in package.json.

mcpServerUrl.title: MCP server URL
mcpServerUrl.description: URL of a remote MCP server endpoint (Streamable HTTP or SSE). When set, the proxy connects to this server through mcp-remote instead of starting the command above.

mcpServerAuthorization.title: Remote MCP server Authorization header
mcpServerAuthorization.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the remote MCP server, e.g. `Bearer YOUR-API-KEY`.
